steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Please wait here a moment,

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Mr. Rat King.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Thank you very much. You are dismissed.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: And excellent marksmanship back there, by the way.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: The praise is much appreciated. And do forgive my rudeness, but you were not injured at all, were you?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Of course not. However, if you ever had any genuine murderous intent towards me...

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Then I never would have had a chance to pull the trigger. You need not be so humble, sir, the Master of the House and myself are well acquainted with your past.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Ah, time is a cruel mistress. Tonight once again reminded me of that fact.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: When one toys with the power to terrify others, one risks seeing himself swallowed whole. Playing with those children full of piss and vinegar saw my precious coat destroyed.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Only your coat?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Needlework is awfully difficult for me.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You have completed your task, Messenger. Return to your master, let him feel at ease that his thing is done.

steps.name: Butler
steps.text: Indeed. But the Master of the House may well want to see you in person. For now, I shall take my leave.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Hm. This place is a disaster. Clearly the work of that penguin.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Ooh, there's an intact bottle of booze here. Mm, looks like some quality stuff.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Would you like a drink?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: A bottle that the Rat King himself deigned to bend over and pick up? How could I refuse?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Listen to you, Chief Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Chief. It's been a long time since I heard you call me that.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And here you are, participating in this little game yourself. I thought you would just pawn it off on Penguin Logistics...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: An old man should look like an old man, be kind, and join in fun with the children.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Heh heh. I still don't feel like you're truly aging. Maybe it's because your daughter looks more and more like you every day. The young you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I don't know how far she can go. Sometimes we need to let them go, but I think we haven't done a very good job on that front.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Even if they choose a dead end?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Even if they choose a dead end.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hah. But then, what path truly takes you that far? And who decides? The Catastrophes?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Maybe you really have gotten old, Lin.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You know why I pay so much attention to that little Messenger? It's because I think they may have something in common.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Now that I think of it, maybe you shouldn't be here in person, Chief.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There are some 'Lungmen citizens' who are 'casually passing by,' we are well aware.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: *Sigh*

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Even the Rat King sighs.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: There are many things that merit a sigh. I just happened to pick one, with gusto.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Maybe it is time to retire.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That's no good. Lungmen still needs her Rat King.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But she can do without Lin. Neither of us are as we once were.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: No matter. I will persevere until the day Lungmen is ready to go without the Rat King.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: That'll be the day my daughter is truly grown.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Is that what you think?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I am her father. And the Rat King of the slums. And once, I was your friend, Lin Gray.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Maybe I can't make a decision. Maybe I've already made many mistakes.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...You are still brooding over the past, Lin.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: When you took Lungmen back for us, I promised you I would stay in the shadow of Wei Yenwu. You need not ever again touch these filthy old alleyways.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Yes. It's been so long. I made that promise, and we have a Rat King.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: You've sacrificed much.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Spare us the crocodile tears. As if I was innocent? When were we ever innocent?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...You kept your promise, old friend. But you also did not hide your misery.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Is that because of your daughter?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I could not make it clearer to you why I would use such a roundabout way of expelling those Siracusans.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There are many troublesome foes. At least I can trust you.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Trust and exploitation are of a kind. Each have a time and place. We must be practical.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...You used to hate this kind of talk.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It's remarkable. We have had so many long-awaited reunions tonight, and yet not a single one has been satisfying.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Don't talk like that. Look, we're two old friends enjoying some scintillating conversation just after Sauin. Let's just relax.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: As you wish. Phew, it's gotten cold. I don't suppose you had time to light a candle for our old comrades in arms?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: That doesn't take much time at all. As soon as you left, there I was.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...I just can't imagine Wei Yenwu bringing flowers to a grave all by his lonesome.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I won't attend your funeral, but maybe I'll bring a bouquet to your grave. Then you'll know.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Could you recall a person who saved your life, and for the trouble was never again able to walk?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There are more such people than we could count. The ones who fought side by side with us, gave their lives for us.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And I will never forget any of them, even for a second.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Your eyes never change. Maybe, just maybe you will live a long time.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: There's a trick to these things.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Either way, you have to live a while longer.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'll take that as a Sauin blessing.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: RAGGEDY-ASS! OLD! RAT!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Hm?!
Marvelous flying kick, Mr. Emperor, but let's show the Rat King a bit more respect.
Good evening, or is it good morning now, Chief Wei?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It was an eventful evening, Mr. Eurill. There were some twists and turns, but everyone got what they needed.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I thought you'd be waiting in the VIP room for everything to resolve itself comfortably.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: To toss my son into imminent danger while I wait warm and comfy in the VIP room for Chief Wei to report back? Does that sound like me?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Who're you callin' imminent danger?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Take it easy, Emperor.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: I ain't even started with your mummy lookin' ass, old man!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: What's to be so upset about? It's just one little hole in your belly I put.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Little?!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Put a little gauze in it. Are you dead? You can't die. Where's the harm?

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: *KACHAK* You ruined my favorite tee, old man, cost me a shitload of paper, and then you come around and do me like this? Hmm?

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Let it go, Mr. Emperor, my company will cover all of the day's expenses.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You shut your mouth. This ain't about money.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Answer me this, Eurill, why'd your man shoot a blank at the Rat King, but this stanky old bastard made a real ass shish kabob outta me?!

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I couldn't resist.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...You're playing a dangerous game here, Emperor.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: My hand slipped.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Now now. Chief Wei is present. Let's clear the air of this murderous energy.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: In any case, the evening's total economic damages don't come anywhere near those of a single Catastrophe, so where's the problem?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Penguin Logistics is a fine place to cut your teeth. All those young ladies, the so-called Messengers, certainly don't make an easy go of it.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: But if I might offer one piece of advice: be careful it doesn't backfire.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Hah, of course! But this is my son we're talking about! Mountain Dash never backs down from a challenge!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: You got Mostima, and all of Lungmen really, playin' tutor to your boy. You got me and this ol' stank-ass rodent as your tools. Can you really afford all this?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Tools? Nonsense.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: I couldn't have foreseen those Siracusans would be so difficult to reason with. I thought they'd work with me after a good rapping on the knuckles.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Bullshit. You had 'em all figured out the moment you laid eyes on 'em.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Well I never.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Heh. How lively.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: From time to time, you take a deep breath in the outskirts and the air has a very particular taste to it.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: As for the Siracusans, no matter how wild the game got, your particular hand was always going to see it turn into something great.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It won't always be so. You know this better than I. But they have yet to contend with Wei Yenwu.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: You may want to be mindful of Siracusa's movements.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: It's too bad. The crusty old mouse couldn't bring you the goods, Wei Yenwu.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: ...Mr. Emperor, such words could hurt one's feelings.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Now, for the offense caused to the Rat King, planned though it was, I do offer my deepest apologies.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: Your man is a very impressive shot, or at least, he's good at portraying one. It makes a man wonder about his background.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Real sad. Coulda been a lot more realistic.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...You really just want to see the whole world burn.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Mr. Eurill, in consideration of the cooperation agreement between Lungmen and your company, it would be wise for you to keep your son away from the center, for the time being.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Hah hah hah! Compared to the potential value of this little venture, that's no trouble at all.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: And Mr. Emperor, I trust you understand why it is Lungmen has always turned a blind eye toward the activities of Penguin Logistics.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Are you telling me it's not because of my outstanding business acumen and immense personal charisma?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: ...Eheh. Indeed. And I believe you see it clearer than anyone.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: *Yawn* Leave me out of it the next time you wanna do something like this! I'ma send you all an invoice and a bill or two. And you can be sure they're comin' with lots of zeroes.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Ahahahaha! That's our Emperor. He never misses a chance to extort a dollar. Maybe I should take a page from his book.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: There are few who would dare to extort the whole of Lungmen. That book is a tough read.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Now then, Chief Wei.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Yes, it's probably time for a change of venue. Everyone has their own business to attend to.

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Huh? You plannin' another elaborate, multi-layered plot with six traps, eight twists, and four turns?

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Would you care to invest? Together, we could move the logistics industry up to a new level. From Lungmen, we could take on all Terra!

steps.name: Emperor
steps.text: Nah. Honestly, I think your company's branding is as crusty as that old rat.

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: Ahahahaha! That's the reason! How regrettable!

steps.name: Eurill
steps.text: But now I think it was your turn to speak?

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Thank you, Lin.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: It is not yet time for thanks.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: I'm not just talking about today. It's been many years.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...The sun is up.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: It 's the first time for me to see the sunrise here. The last time we stood shoulder to shoulder like this, was a time of terrible bloodshed.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: The way the tenements in the slums wrap around each other, causing the shadows to criss cross over themselves, it's not the kind of thing you should get used to.

steps.name: Wei Yenwu
steps.text: Then, after all these years, what is it you see here?

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...Changes, Mr. Wei.

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: On that road we walked...

steps.name: Rat King
steps.text: ...there is long since no one behind us.
